full_page.content:
1936 , January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 85 Jan. 15 Wm. P. Breen, Jr. - 20 - had fearful accident last Nov. two yrs. ago (playing foot-ball). Had operation on both sides of brain - was considered hopeless when father Enrolled him in S. Masses perpetually. To-day is better & brighter than ever. Deo Grat.
17 Loraine Gowenlock - 21 - double cataracts ... father ... nothing ... presbiterian
S. Price - 44 - Presbiterian once - his wife was trying to reform a relative when her husband S.P. ran away with her.
Sister M. Angel Guardian
James Barthol - 63 - Father of Ed. B. who fell at the altar-rail 9 or 10 yrs. ago.
Venzeno Milello - 16 - giving up Religion - one time altar-boy.
21 Sister Rose Marie SSJ. - 29 - nerves ... break ...
Page 86 Jan. Thomas Mears - 78 - non Cath. - Pneumonia relapse - Drs. have no hope. Enrolled at 3:45 P.M.
Cha's Wagner - 35 - away from wife & two small children six mo. They - anxious.
Richard Davis - 7 - of Chicago, blind and boils, etc. - wanted to bring him hither but could not.
Mary Bancroft - Suffering severly from infected antrum. .. Mrs ..... 78 of St. Louis Mo. - Enemia - Telegram.
John Steffens - 30 - heart tourble in St. Jo's Hospital. Wife "Scientist" - hesitate to have a priest .. . . .
Charlotte Heil - 33 - cancer of - has husband and child.
Anne Cyr ... work - sick brother to sup.
Page 87 Jan. 28. AAnn C, Fitzpatrick - middle-aged - asks for prayers for employment - compitent ..... when almost penniless received payment of $5.00 debt. Gives in act of faith.
